observation: WT to KO: Rin 102.9 to 143.0 MOhm (+39 percent), rest -79.3 to -73.6 mV, tau 18.6 to 21.3 ms; HT equals KO on Rin and is intermediate on rest; bursts in 36/42 KO, 4/23 HT, 0/11 WT slices (34634460 Table 1; hcn physiology Y01-Y03).
relation_qualified: A Ba2+-sensitive resting K+ conductance (Kir2-type and/or a K2P-type leak; not separable with Ba2+) carries about 23 percent of the resting conductance of a WT L2/3 neuron (D01, S01) and Ba2+ block raises Rin about 30 percent with a small depolarisation and a lower rheobase (S01); the Wwox pair implies a lost conductance of about 28 percent whose implied reversal (-93.7 KO, -88.8 HT, recorded scale) lies in the K+ range and apart from the maturation values (-72 to -79) (IR); a known Ba2+-sensitive current gain (Fmr1 KO) gives the mirror pattern (Rin -28 percent, rest -3.7 mV, implied -91.6 against a measured Ba2+ reversal -89.6) (D13, S02-S04, IR).
proposed_action_class: Add or restore a resting K+ conductance of about 2.7 nS (reversal near E_K) to the KO neuron: experimentally by dynamic clamp; pharmacologically only an activator class acting on a Ba2+-sensitive resting channel (no neocortical K2P tool located, D09; no Kir2 activator in the catalogue).
favourable_context: A Ba2+-sensitive current (Kir2-type) per pF smaller in KO and HT than in WT, with reversal near the corrected E_K, measured with synaptic transmission blocked and the junction potential measured; capacitance and access resistance reported; dynamic-clamp re-addition restores Rin and rest.
opposite_context: Ba2+-sensitive current per pF equal across genotypes; or the contrast shrinks under blockade or matched access resistance; or capacitance is lower and tau scales so that the pair follows from cell size; or the implied reversal after the measured junction correction is outside K+ range.
expected_functional_result: Rin, rest, rheobase and gain move toward WT; bursts may fall only if intrinsic gain is limiting. HT carries the full Rin change and rarely bursts, so intrinsic change alone is not sufficient for bursts (DATO from Table 1; HT versus KO untested in the paper).
refuting_measure: Difference-current ladder (K-EXP step 2), then dynamic clamp (step 5).
premise: The Ba2+-sensitive share is the same in this preparation (P13-P17, layer II/III, somatosensory, 35 C) as in the adult auditory-cortex source; Ba2+ at 60 uM is neuron-autonomous (glial Kir4.1 not excluded: UNSOURCED_BACKGROUND, to be sourced or dropped).
function_that_could_improve: Intrinsic excitability (input-output gain, rheobase, resting state). Not stated: seizure, development.
usefulness_without_wwox_repair: Yes: a hyperpolarising conductance can be useful as compensation whether or not WWOX is restored; the premise (a deficit of that conductance) is not needed for the compensation to act, but is needed to call it a repair.
label: INFERENZA (arithmetic on printed means) + IPOTESI

observation: Rest is below the activation range of Kv7 (rest -79 to -74 recorded, about 8-16 mV more negative after junction correction, D14-D15); no AHP, adaptation or Kv7 current is reported for Wwox neurons; the F-I slope is reported not to differ once shifted to rheobase (supplement unread).
relation_qualified: Kv7 current starts near -70 mV (D03); XE991 has no effect at -70 mV on a recombinant channel and half-inhibits near -51 mV, so a null XE991 effect at rest says nothing about the share (D05); KCNQ2 loss raised Rin 25 percent with rest near -67 mV (D04) but with a higher AP count and smaller mAHP, and Ank2-cKO L2/3 neurons (Kv7 protein reduced) showed higher current-spike slope with retigabine rescuing mAHP and spike count (S12-S13, functional only).
proposed_action_class: A Kv7 opener as a spike-frequency and AHP stabiliser acting in the subthreshold-to-spiking range, not on resting Rin or rest; read as a mechanism comparator for the K+ lever and as a possible compensation.
favourable_context: An XE991-sensitive current at about -55 to -45 mV smaller in KO/HT, mAHP smaller, adaptation weaker, gain steeper.
opposite_context: XE991-sensitive current equal; mAHP equal; F-I slope equal at matched rheobase (as the paper reports); or an opener raises spiking in a Wwox slice (the HCN1 gain-of-function mouse precedent: retigabine increased ECoG spiking, abstract-level, IT35).
expected_functional_result: Fewer spikes per burst-initiating depolarisation and a longer AHP; no change of Rin or rest. Burst effect unknown.
refuting_measure: XE991-sensitive current at -55 mV and mAHP by genotype (step 3).
premise: A Kv7 deficit exists in the spiking range of Wwox neurons (unmeasured); the published unchanged F-I slope argues against it.
function_that_could_improve: Spike-frequency adaptation and AHP, not resting state.
usefulness_without_wwox_repair: Yes, as compensation, without any claim of a Kv7 lesion (a response does not show a lesion).
label: IPOTESI, weakened by an observation already in the record

observation: Sag at -200 pA 1.18, 2.04, 2.57 mV and rebound larger only in KO; Rin higher.
relation_qualified: Ih carries about 6 percent of the resting conductance in WT L2/3 and its block lowers sag from 1.8 to 1.0 mV and hyperpolarises 4.7 mV (D07); it carries most of the conductance at -80 mV in deep layers (D08, data not shown, not L2/3). A larger Rin drives a cell further for the same step, so the absolute sag can rise without more HCN (IT36/IT40).
proposed_action_class: HCN block is a tool arm for sag and rebound and for the hyperpolarising effect on rest; it cannot carry the 28 percent resting conductance by itself (about 6 percent in the source).
favourable_context: Excess sag persists at matched potential and deflection and a ZD7288-sensitive current per pF is larger in KO.
opposite_context: Excess sag vanishes at matched conditions or the ZD7288-sensitive current per pF is equal.
expected_functional_result: Sag and rebound reflect recruitment by a more resistive cell, not a difference in HCN.
refuting_measure: Matched-deflection sag and the ZD7288-sensitive current in the same cells (step 4).
premise: Existing INV-18 main arm; here only its share of the conductance is added.
label: DATO (share from another preparation) + INFERENZA

observation: Intrinsic changes are as large in HT as in KO (Rin 143.26 vs 143.03) while bursts are 4/23 versus 36/42; the recordings were probably made with synapses intact (inference from the Methods drug list).
relation_qualified: If the K+ conductance change were produced by network activity (extracellular K+ or activity-dependent regulation), the HT, which rarely bursts, should not show the full Rin change; it does (DATO from Table 1; HT v KO untested). Ba2+ at 60 uM was applied with synapses intact and spontaneous EPSPs present in the preprint (S01).
proposed_action_class: No neuron-targeted drug: a network consequence is addressed upstream (INV-05 axis) or by glial K+ buffering (no activator in the catalogue).
favourable_context: The contrast shrinks under synaptic blockade, or in non-bursting KO slices.
opposite_context: The contrast is unchanged under blockade and in non-bursting KO and HT slices (supports an intrinsic origin).
expected_functional_result: If consequence: K+ levers act downstream of the cause and cannot be a repair.
refuting_measure: Step 1: the same cells recorded with and without blockers, bursting and non-bursting slices.
premise: Wwox slices are recorded with synapses intact in the source paper (inferred, not stated).
label: INFERENZA (HT versus KO argument)

observation: P13-P17 sits in a steep transition: Rin falls about 47 percent per interval from P7 to P28, rest hyperpolarises 8.3 then 3.1 mV, tau falls with Rin so capacitance is about constant (prelimbic L3, 188 to 180 pF) (D10, S19); Kv7 current density about doubles P11-14 to P20-24 (D11).
relation_qualified: A maturation delay would raise Rin and depolarise rest like the Wwox pair, but the implied reversal of the developmental conductance gain is -72 to -79 mV, not -89 to -94 (IR), and tau rises with Rin at constant capacitance, whereas Wwox tau is flat (18.6, 18.8, 21.3 ms): a delay at constant capacitance predicts tau up about 39 percent. Cell size alone (C down) predicts Rin up and tau flat but not a depolarised rest unless a fixed seal shunt is added (IT40).
proposed_action_class: No pharmacological lever; the measurement of capacitance, tau, ages and weights decides whether any K arm is needed.
favourable_context: Capacitance lower in mutants and tau flat; ages, weights and layer matched; the K+ difference current per pF equal.
opposite_context: Capacitance equal with higher Rin (conductance lost); the implied reversal stays K-like after the measured junction correction.
refuting_measure: Capacitance and tau in the same cells (step 0).
premise: Developmental data are from prelimbic cortex at 31 C: a transfer in region and temperature.
label: INFERENZA
